# pts01: skip impossible passive-camp attacks in three threat scans

Base `2f0f534e8311ee597e516b11c2afca1bbf608060`, base bot `leader_party_tuned`. Candidate `bots/pi_passive-threat-skip-01/` only. Independent release optimization; inherit NO profiler or objective experiment. Write IMPLEMENTATION.md.

## Evidence and semantic contract

Current reference5 SDK documents gem_cluster and gold_cluster as nonattacking. Their `kind()/is_gem_cluster()/is_gold_cluster()` checks use the camp handle's cached immutable type with no host import. Current engine3 build96ce858f548c14560eff737967a691a30eaf0a469afd1f4f400f125e094bd1fd probe, Swirl58/Vault61 passive members, confirms both types have base_strength0 and strength_growth0; zero probe faults. SDK-supported camp/champion effects do not supply a cluster Strength-growth buff. This agrees with the documented nonattacking rule.

Existing observation code nonetheless queries is_alive, is_awake and strength on each visible resource cluster in three threat-only loops. An asleep cluster incurs two state imports; an awake zero-strength cluster adds a strength query before being discarded. Repeated incoming_at scans multiply this work. Preserve vision::camps enumeration and all damaging-camp queries; this proposal does not cache live state or change visibility semantics.

Diagnostic scopes show observe as a large cost component but full/masked profiler output perturbs trajectories, so do NOT claim measured release speedup from that trace. The type-filter premise is independently supported by the SDK/current runtime. New uninstrumented release games decide its value.

## Exact isolated change

Add an early cached-type exclusion for gem_cluster OR gold_cluster in exactly these three existing threat scans:

1. `observations.cpp::incoming_at` visible-camp loop.
2. `observations.cpp::observe` visible-camp loop that sets camp_hit.
3. `navigation.cpp::move_to` safe-blocking visible-camp loop.

For both passive types, skip BEFORE calling is_alive/is_awake/strength/position/range. For every other type, preserve the exact original query order, comparisons, damage sum and danger mask. A tiny common predicate is acceptable if inlined and backed by cached type checks only; do not create a new threat framework. Do not remove passive camps from blocked occupancy, map groups, combat targets, capture logic or movement collision. No other loops, flags, thresholds, draft, shopping, planner, action order or cache invalidation changes. No telemetry/logging/profiler code. Preserve pathfinding algorithms and all same-round guards. The intended pointwise threat result is unchanged; saved fuel can legitimately change execution timing and match trajectories.

## Focused checks

Verify actual edited loop/predicate with passive asleep/awake/dead cases producing no incoming damage/camp_hit/risk block and no live queries; a damaging awake camp still contributes identical damage and masks; sleeping/dead attacking camps remain handled exactly as before. Include mixed visible groups and occupied passive tiles to ensure physical collision remains unchanged. Fake SDK/call counters are appropriate for the pointwise/query contract, but document that they do not prove engine/fuel performance. Run available existing native scenarios and SDK syntax checks; report actual gaps. No test that merely repeats a boolean expression without exercising production behavior.

## PC gate frozen before outcomes

Exact-source CLI5/current-engine release build, normal fuel, zero candidate VM faults. Run standard80-game screen:8maps,5 frozen controls,both sides, matched current-engine baseline64 common. Reject if direct champion<8/16 OR common<31/64; expand for strength only if direct>=9/16 AND common>=35/64. Otherwise label inconclusive, with mechanism inspection. Do not promote a microoptimization solely for lower fuel events if scoring regresses.

Mechanism: per-map/actor fuelExhausted counts (separate initialization1–2, first100, whole game), completed camp captures, banked gems, deaths and score. Whole-game pauses depend on duration, so compare early windows and timing as well. Explicitly inspect Swirl both sides againstC02 using original baseline fixtures, no profiler in either artifact. If observations remain dominant or pauses do not improve, do not broaden claim to all runtime work. Any diagnostic ON rerun stays separate from strength evidence.

If screen qualifies, predeclare broader diverse-opponent/new-development-map tests before viewing outcomes; preserve16 confirmation maps and require fresh confirmation before ranked recommendation. No upload from screen alone. Interaction with dt01's dense passive group is a separate later experiment, not part of this job. Leave commit/push to bridge.
